title: OrgsInviteOutput
description: Ids-only outcome. `delivery` is `sent` (the inviter's brokered email connection delivered the accept link) — a `skipped` delivery from a run is rolled back and surfaces as a TYPED failure (422 undeliverable / delivery_failed), never success over a zombie row. A refusal (no acting user, disabled actor, missing scope, foreign org, no OPENWOP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL) is a typed node failure. Never the email, never the token.

delivery.description: Delivery outcome (`sent` on the run lane; `skipped` is only reachable where the caller can hand the token out, which a run cannot).
